regions.merged_text: E'd R. Brock - 45 - City constable believed to be dying three weeks ago. His sister phoned Wednesday P.M. to ask for prayers for him - leaving the telephone she found his blood circulation had come back and he is improving ever since. Thanks be to God.

regions.merged_text: Mrs. Julia Markes - about 50 - gangreen-foot. Drs. in Ann Arbor Hospital tried to induce her to have leg amputated .... She insisted notwithstanding great pain on leaving Hospital and coming hither. Here To-night and enrolled (2.00) .. 15th Decidedly better. Jan. 11, '40 Saw her To-day - foot saved, alive again.
